body.title: Array.prototype.map()
body.summary:
The map() method of Array instances creates
a new array populated with the results of calling a provided function on
every element in the calling array.

body.title: CSS grid layout
body.summary: The CSS grid layout module excels at dividing a page into major regions or defining the relationship in terms of size, position, and layering between parts of a control built from HTML primitives.

body.title: grid-template-columns CSS property
body.summary: The grid-template-columns CSS property defines the line names and track sizing functions of the grid columns.
